scope: actual map registry range and permission checks
copy direction flag and bounded memmove

findings.detail: mmap only selects shared file or anonymous private flags, no MAP_FIXED or executable permission; page is checked against the caller-issued actual auxv page and rounded extent is overflow checked. Real returned address plus rounded extent is also checked before registry commit.

copy finds each exact live base in the current actual context, checks destination WRITE/source READ and full logical count before access. Previously recorded base+rounded overflow check plus count<=logical<=rounded bounds the later LEAs. memmove overlap order and DF restore are explicit.

munmap resolves only current-context live mapping, requires identical rounded extent, consumes it to quarantine before its one syscall, clears the record only on real zero success, and leaves failures quarantined. context_empty sees live and quarantine entries and prevents metadata reuse.

barrier comment says any nonzero mutex is a reentrancy/corruption fault. lock bts checks only bit 0; values with other bits set and bit 0 clear pass, with those bits remaining. If the full-word-zero invariant is required, check the entire word before bts under the stated single-thread executor; otherwise narrow the comment to bit 0. This is static private metadata framing, not a demonstrated public syscall defect.

This fragment is not standalone. The full immutable 256-byte r13 event extent, callee image/source/entry/lease correlation, actual auxv capture, context lifetime/quarantine retention, signal/fatal semantics and exactly-once wrapping of the raw result remain responsibilities of the final fixed caller.

nonclaims: No ordinary namespace or DMS qualification
No claim that private metadata headers authenticate arbitrary supplied pointers
No inherited results from previous memory/fencing revisions
